title: Shinonome Ena — A Shadow Out Of Sight〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Then, let's get started.
We're all continuing where we left off in the afternoon, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, my plan is to finish working on that cut with the outstretched hand sometime tonight.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Really?! You sound all wound up and ready to go, Enanan!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <If things go well, I might actually finish tomorrow afternoon.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <I don't know if I'll be here tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Still, don't you want to finish what we've been working on together...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <We'll let you know when we're about to upload it, so try to be there for that. I mean, it was a group effort...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <Then, I'll see what I can do...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The four of us are making this video together, so Mafuyu should be here to see it go up...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You'll be able to wrap things up by noon if I get my illustration to you by morning, right, Amia?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yup. The sooner I get your illustration, the higher the chances are of me finishing in time.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, don't put so much pressure on me like that.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Having it finished by noon would be preferable, but there's no need to push yourselves harder than necessary.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I know, but we've come this far.
I don't wanna start cutting corners now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What she said! I'll get started once you're finished drawing the rough sketch for that hand asset.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Also, Enanan, don't forget to let me know if you wanna make any changes to it.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Okay, relax.
I have a pretty clear image in my head, so I doubt I'll be doing that.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The fingers shouldn't be extended out so straight. This makes it look like she's doing the saving...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(It needs to go with the lyrics more.
This hand needs to say, “Save me.”)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(It's in the lyrics for this song...
But it takes a lot of courage to ask someone to do that.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (You'd usually end up wondering if it's okay to ask someone that, or if anyone's actually gonna help...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Getting this to feel right isn't gonna be easy, but Mafuyu's lyrics have given me a clear picture.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I can do it...
No, I have to.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I took a quick nap after I sent the video over to K. Oh, but she also said she wanted to rest a little before making any final edits.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay. I'm glad she didn't have to pull an all-nighter.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Sorry for being late. I lost track of time while working.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It's okay since Yuki isn't here yet.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay. I'm almost finished making my edits, so I'll continue to work.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <She said that she'd let us know if she can't... But we haven't received word, so she should be here soon, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What do you think she's gonna say when she sees the final version of our video...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Her? I can't imagine a whole lot...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But I have a really good feeling about this video! You even went out of your way to draw extra illustrations for it, Enanan!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <This video would feel totally different without that, right? Plus, you're pretty proud about how they turned out, aren't you?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, and I had a much clearer picture in my head as to what I was gonna draw compared to normal...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, along with all of N25's followers, I think Yuki's gonna really like what we made!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<But her being her...
I wouldn't get your hopes up too much.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah, and she hasn't said anything...
Her lunch break should've begun already...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Do you think she's waiting for us to let her know that it's finished...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thank you for waiting. I've finished making my final edits.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh, K, perfect!
We can tell Yuki that our video's ready for upload!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Lunch break for Miya Girls is probably over by now, huh? Do you think she had a lot to do or something...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But she said she'd let us know if she did...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Let's give her a little more time...
There may be a reason as to why she can't immediately reply.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I don't have the best radar when it comes to these sorts of things, but I'm starting to get a really bad feeling...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <If she doesn't reply by the time school gets out for her, maybe we can Miku see what's going on...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I agree. We should try asking them.>
